steps.name: apply-stage17b-ml-decision-docs-recovery
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=698d4e7e31a192a19b9f18cc0d11ea7a1a146fa6; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage17/apply_stage17b_ml_decision_docs.py > /tmp/apply-stage17b-ml-decision-docs.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage17b-ml-decision-docs.py; perl -pi -e 's/[ \t]+$//' docs/ML_DECISION_REPORT.md docs/MODEL_PIPELINE.md docs/MVP_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLLER.md docs/CHANGELOG.md; .venv/bin/python -m json.tool docs/ML_DECISION_REPORT.json >/dev/null; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage17b-doc-consistency-recovery
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; grep -q '44 -> 32 -> 32 -> 6' docs/MODEL_PIPELINE.md; grep -q 'Runtime direction' docs/MODEL_PIPELINE.md; grep -q 'Stage 16' docs/ML_DECISION_REPORT.md; grep -q '"runtime_authority": "rule"' docs/ML_DECISION_REPORT.json; grep -q 'Current implementation checkpoint' docs/MVP_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROLLER.md; ! grep -q '128 → 32 → 32 → 15' docs/MODEL_PIPELINE.md; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage17b-recovery
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Freeze climate ML decisions through Stage 16'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
